Based on the visual evidence provided in the image, here are the precise answers to your questions:

1) **Yes.** There is a visible day selector dropdown labeled **"Dan 1"**. The chips like **'Manj vožnje'**, **'Več narave'**, etc., are visually grouped directly underneath this selector and the label **"Prilagodi ta dan"** (Adjust this day), which clearly indicates they affect the currently selected day.

2) **No.** The specific chips you mentioned (**'Ceneje'**, **'Bolj aktivno'**, **'Bolj mirno'**) are **not visible** in this screenshot. The only chip that might imply a global scope is **"Za družino"** (For family), but it does not explicitly state it affects the whole trip.

3) **Yes.** There is hint text explaining the scope of the first group. The text reads: **"Opisi spremembo ali uporabi hitro akcijo za posamezen dan"** (Describes the change or use a quick action for an individual day). Additionally, there is smaller text below the chips stating: **"Hitre akcije delujejo tudi brez AI (deterministično)"** (Quick actions also work without AI (deterministic)).

4) **No.** There is no loading state (such as a spinner or skeleton effect) visible on any of the chips. They all appear fully rendered and static.
